title: Kaushik Joglekar
intro:
Report an officeholder change
Kaushik Joglekar is a member of the Oak Grove School District board of trustees in California, representing Area 3. He assumed office on February 13, 2025. His current term ends on December 11, 2026.
Joglekar is running for re-election to the Oak Grove School District board of trustees to represent Area 3 in California. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Joglekar completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
Oak Grove School District Board of Trustees appointed Joglekar to the Oak Grove School District Trustee Area 3 on February 4, 2025.
